title: Rukmini Maitra to Lead Opposite Akshay Kumar in Sci-Fi Thriller Samuk, Reports Say
excerpt: The Bengali star, who debuted in Hindi cinema with Sanak, is reported to be the female lead in Vipul Amrutlal Shah's alien survival thriller, now shooting in the UK for a 2027 release.
body:
• Bengali actor Rukmini Maitra has been reported as the female lead opposite Akshay Kumar in Samuk, a sci-fi action thriller directed by Kanishk Varma.
  • The film, produced by Vipul Amrutlal Shah under Sunshine Pictures, is shooting in the UK and is expected to release in 2027.
  • Samuk blends survival horror and alien-thriller elements, with creature effects by Alec Gillis of the Alien and Predator franchises.
  • Maitra made her Hindi debut with Sanak (2021) — also directed by Varma — and built her career in Bengali cinema with films such as Binodini and Byomkesh O Durgo Rahasya.

Bengali cinema star Rukmini Maitra is set for her biggest Hindi film role yet: reports say she has been locked as the female lead opposite Akshay Kumar in Samuk, the large-scale sci-fi action thriller now in production. Cinema Express, citing Variety, reported the casting as Akshay Kumar began shooting the film; Variety India said the makers wanted an actor with "intensity and a screen presence" to complement Kumar. Details of her character are being kept under wraps, and the production has not issued a formal casting announcement.

An alien thriller mounted at international scale

Samuk is directed by Kanishk Varma and produced by Vipul Amrutlal Shah under Sunshine Pictures, co-produced by Aashin A. Shah. The makers describe it as a survival alien thriller combining practical creature effects, military realism and old-school horror aesthetics. The production has hired creature FX designer Alec Gillis, known for the Alien and Predator franchises including Alien: Romulus (2024), to design the film's alien, and British stunt coordinator Luke Tumber, whose credits include Mission: Impossible, the Venom films, Star Wars and No Time To Die.

"Cinema Express , citing Variety, reported the casting as Akshay Kumar began shooting the film; Variety India said the makers wanted an actor with "intensity and a screen presence" to complement Kumar."

The film also reunites Akshay Kumar with Shah after a long gap — their collaborations include Aankhen (2002), Waqt: The Race Against Time (2005), Namastey London (2007), Action Replayy (2010) and Holiday (2014). Samuk has been in development for over two years and is being shot extensively in the United Kingdom, with a 2027 release planned.

A Bengali star's second Hindi chapter

Maitra is not a newcomer to Hindi cinema — she debuted in it with Sanak (2021), the Vidyut Jammwal action film that Varma also directed, and appeared in Crakk (2024). But the bulk of her career is in Bengali cinema, where she has moved across genres: the period drama Binodiini – Ekti Natir Upakhyan, in which she played theatre legend Binodini Dasi; the sci-fi comedy Boomerang, in a dual role including an andro-humanoid; and Byomkesh O Durgo Rahasya, Kishmish, Password, Kabir and Chaamp.

She has said she does not want to be restricted by language or typecasting — "I am interested in films, not just in Hindi, but in any language if the content is strong," she said in a 2025 interview — and has spoken about choosing roles that make her characters indispensable to the story. A lead role opposite one of Hindi cinema's biggest action stars, in a genre Bengali actors rarely headline in Bollywood, is the clearest test yet of that strategy. South Indian actors have frequently crossed over opposite A-listers; a Bengali lead in a tentpole Hindi production is a rarer bridge, and Samuk's makers appear to be building it deliberately.
